technical_requirements: Indexing scale: plan for 50M+ embeddings, support sharded indexes and incremental reindexing
Vector DB connectors: must support pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Elastic (hybrid search) with consistent metadata filtering
CDC & ingestion: support logical replication from Postgres + S3 bulk import + dedupe on ingest
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to sparse BM25 in Elastic when vector recall below threshold
Reranking: ability to run cross-encoder rerankers on dedicated GPU pool; support batching and async scoring
Latency SLOs: retrieval p99 < 100ms (local region), rerank p95 < 250ms; end-to-end query p99 < 350ms for primary workflows
Cost controls: token and serving cost breakdowns, per-route batching rules, recommended quantization profiles
Multi-region: active-passive replicas for region residency; two-region replication for disaster recovery
ACLs & multi-tenancy: per-namespace ACLs, metadata-level authorization, query auditing
Connector features: synchronous upserts, eventual-consistent acknowledgements, bulk downsample for cold archives
